LanguageData.NR_BDNeedsDevice: needs braindance goggles or a cyberlink
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_Noticed: Your intrusions are starting to be linked together.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_Tracked: Someone is deliberately tracing the source of the signal.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_Target: Your colony is a known target. Expect an answer.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_RedZone: The whole network can see you.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelUp: Digital trace: {0}. The network is paying closer attention to your colony.
LanguageData.NR_AlertHeatDesc:
Your colony's digital trace is {0} out of 100 ({1}).

Every successful hack leaves a trace. Hackers with higher stealth leave less of it, and hacking from a cyberpod is quieter still.

The trace cools down by {2} per day on its own.

Levels: Shadow 0–24, Noticed 25–49, Tracked 50–74, Target 75–94, Red Zone 95–100.
LanguageData.NR_CommandNetTerminalDesc: Open the network terminal: your digital trace, fixers, contracts and the journal of recent events.
LanguageData.NR_CyberpodBonusData: {0} pulled an extra cyberdata through the cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsDiveReportTip: After leaving a dive, open a window with the haul, costs, Heat and Netsick.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsNewcomer: Network events only after the colony goes online
LanguageData.NR_SettingsNewcomerTip: Netrun threats (net attacks, corporate hunts, mercenaries, AI and fixer events) wait until the colony has touched the net: any Heat, a cyberpod, console or AI server built, a colonist with a cyberlink, or a dive. Black market and distress signal come anyway.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsDifficultyTip: A preset for how fast Heat grows, how fast it cools and how much a fixer scrubs. Fine-tune under "Advanced".
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFreqAttacksTip: Net attacks, mercenary raids and the corporate hunt.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFreqMapTip: Data courier, black market, distress signal, turret hijack.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFreqCyberTip: ICE hunter, rival netrunners, honeypots, data storms, wild AIs.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsAIEventFrequencyTip: AI events: requests, favors and tricks of your AIs.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsAIAvailabilityTip: How often AI fragments turn up: in hacks, dives, distress signals and emotional dives. Low halves every chance, high gives one and a half times.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsPauseTip: The game pauses once when the terminal opens; you can unpause it while it is open.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsAnimationsTip: Floating Gateway nodes and glowing Core sections. Turn off if the terminal feels slow.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsReportInfoDesc: Found a bug? Copy the info below and paste it into the bug report on GitHub with your Player.log.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsReportInfo: Copy info for a bug report
LanguageData.NR_SettingsUnlockHelpTip: Unlocks the spoiler articles (boss node, hacker group…) in this game.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFont: Terminal font: Tektur (off: the standard font)
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFontTip: The mod's windows use the Tektur font (SIL Open Font License). Turn off to use the game's font.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsSoundPackTip: The sounds of the terminal, dives and AIs. All packs are made for this mod; pick by ear.
LanguageData.NR_SoundPackDesc_Clean: A neon night: warm analog pads, glassy e-piano signals, a distant siren.
LanguageData.NR_SoundPackDesc_Minimal: A cold room: short clean pips, a quiet drone and a far bell. Very sparse.
LanguageData.NR_SoundPackDesc_Neon: Synthwave: supersaw pads, bass arpeggios, saw plucks and gated echo.
LanguageData.NR_SoundPackDesc_RetroDeck: An 80s cyberdeck: 8-bit chip sounds, relays, modem warbles, sonar.
LanguageData.NR_SoundPackDesc_Deep: Heavy abyss: bowed drones, huge bells, gongs and long echo.
LanguageData.NR_SoundPackDesc_Off: No mod sounds: only the game's own click.
LanguageData.NR_HackHeatPreview: Trace if hacked: about +{0} Heat (less with hacking stealth or from a cyberpod)
LanguageData.NR_SettingsAmbientEach: Each ambient on its own (share of the ambient volume):
LanguageData.NR_SettingsResetGroupTip: Put the settings of «{0}» back to their defaults.
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwNote_Market: Easy loot and little trace. Good for the first dives.
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwNote_Archive: Knowledge: sometimes research or skill experience.
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwNote_Corp: Rich loot, but every step leaves 1.5 times the trace. Often a contract node (★).
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwNote_Abandoned: AI fragments live here, and sometimes a wild AI in the memory.
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwNote_DarkExchange: Silver and valuables. Its Black ICE hits hard: bring a shield or a decoy.
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwNote_CorpCore: Comes every few weeks for a few days. When it falls, the corps go on lockdown for a week.
LanguageData.NR_HelpGwHome: Your home hub: every dive starts here.
LanguageData.NR_HelpHackStrength: Strength of the gate or ICE: {0}
LanguageData.NR_HelpHackFlow: Net flow after a clean dive (+{0})
LanguageData.NR_HelpHackClamp: The chance always stays between 5% and 95%.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTraceAmount: Trace of the dive (steps and actions): {0}
LanguageData.NR_HelpTraceNote: This node type multiplies the trace by {0}. A cyberpod with an AI coprocessor lowers it further.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIUnknown: You have not met this archetype yet. Awaken an AI of it to see its card.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAITrust: Trust: {0} (move it to see what opens)
LanguageData.NR_HelpAITrustBetray: Below {0}: it sells the colony out and leaves.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAITrustEscape: Below {0} with hunger over {1}: it tries to run away.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAITrustTrait1: From {0}: the first trait shows (plus and minus).
LanguageData.NR_HelpAITrustEvents: From {0}: its own events are friendly.
LanguageData.NR_HelpFixerRep: Reputation: {0} (purple mark: trait, gold mark: pinned)
LanguageData.NR_HelpFixerTraitHidden: Trait: ??? ({0} more reputation to see it)
LanguageData.NR_HelpFixerPinned: Pinned: stays through rotations (up to {0} pinned at once).
LanguageData.NR_HelpFixerRareOn: Rare goods are in the shop.
LanguageData.NR_HelpContractStageDesc_Board: Each fixer without a running job keeps an offer. A call opens the channel to take it.
LanguageData.NR_HelpContractStageDesc_Taken: One job per fixer at a time. The deadline starts now.
LanguageData.NR_HelpContractStageDesc_Work: Hacks, dives, deliveries: whatever the job asks. A dive into a node marked ★ counts twice.
LanguageData.NR_HelpContractStageDesc_Pay: Silver by drop pod and reputation. A failure costs {0} reputation and {1} days of silence.
LanguageData.NR_HelpBDStepRaw: Raw recording: the goggles catch a strong moment.
LanguageData.NR_HelpBDStepEdit: Editing at the network console (from the Studio).
LanguageData.NR_HelpBDTier_1: Great: a good memory after watching.
LanguageData.NR_HelpBDTier_2: Masterful: a strong memory after watching.
LanguageData.NR_HelpIceDesc_Strike: ICE ahead strikes at the end of a turn with a {0} chance; a hack that fails on ICE draws a strike too.
LanguageData.NR_HelpIceDesc_Shield: Each Shield charge swallows one strike whole.
LanguageData.NR_HelpIceDesc_Decoy: A Decoy charge leads a strike away with a {1} chance.
LanguageData.NR_HelpIceDesc_Killer: A Killer charge breaks the next gate or ICE outright: no strike can come from it.
LanguageData.NR_HelpIceDesc_Hit: A hit that gets through: +{2} Netsick, then nausea (60%), a lockout (30%, the dive ends) or a coma (10%). Black ICE can also burn out the cyberlink ({3} per hit).
LanguageData.NR_DiagnosticsTip: Versions, DLC, mods, changed settings, the state of the net and the last Netrun errors, copied to the clipboard. No personal data. Paste it into your bug report.
LanguageData.NR_HelpFixerScrubValue: {0} Heat per cyberdata in the Shadow
LanguageData.NR_HelpLoadoutChance: Hack chance (Intellectual 8 vs a strength-3 gate)
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Core: The ring is your Heat. Click it for the Heat screen: the scale, the graph of the week, what raised it and every way to bring it down. Around it, "Now" suggests the most useful action and "Alerts" lists what is burning.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Club: Fixers live here: the pool, reputation, calls, the shop, scrubbing the trace, and the hacker group.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Board: Contracts from the fixers: pick a job, follow its progress, collect the pay.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Archive: The log of your trace: every hack, dive, scrub and event, with filters and the history of the week.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Server: Awakened AIs: their trust and hunger, services, requests, hosts and coprocessors.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Studio: Braindance: raw recordings to edit, the chip library and the addiction of your colonists.
LanguageData.NR_HelpTermNodeDesc_Gateway: Cyberspace: the map of external nodes, the loadout before a dive, and the dive itself.
LanguageData.NR_HelpChecklist_Console: Build a comms console: it becomes the network console and opens the terminal.
LanguageData.NR_HelpChecklist_Link: Give a colonist a cyberlink: now they can hack.
LanguageData.NR_HelpChecklist_Hack: Hack any target: the first Heat appears and the Core opens.
LanguageData.NR_HelpChecklist_Fixer: Call a fixer in the Club and make a first deal.
LanguageData.NR_HelpChecklist_Dive: Dive into a node from the Gateway.
LanguageData.NR_HelpChecklist_AI: Wake an AI fragment on an AI server.
LanguageData.NR_HelpHackHeatNote: One hack leaves between {0} and {1} Heat: more for a stronger target, less with stealth or from a pod.
LanguageData.NR_HelpNewcomerOpen: the colony is in the net: threats can come
LanguageData.NR_HelpNewcomerClosed: not in the net yet: you are protected
LanguageData.NR_HelpNewcomerBlocksList: network attacks, mercenaries, corporate hunts, the data courier
LanguageData.NR_HelpNewcomerAlwaysList: the black market, the distress signal
LanguageData.NR_HelpLowerContractValue: a fixer pays {0} silver for each point you bring down
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeService_Server: Yes: services work only from the main server.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeHunger_Server: Grows every day by {1}; you feed it.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeGives_Server: Its archetype's service, requests and events. Racks add slots, up to three.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeService_Coprocessor: No service: it works for the cyberpod it is linked to.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeHunger_Coprocessor: Grows as on the server; feed it.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeGives_Coprocessor: Help in dives: less trace, less Netsick, a cheaper dive, its own bonus by archetype.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeService_Host: No service: no uplink from a socket.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeHunger_Host: Falls by {0} a day: it feeds on the host.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHomeGives_Host: A passive bonus to the host, by archetype. No requests while it rides along.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenSrcDesc_Dive: A cyberspace find on a clean exit, more often in an abandoned server.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenSrcDesc_Memory: Download a memory step in a dive.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenSrcDesc_WildAI: Tame one you meet in a node's memory.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenSrcDesc_Distress: Connect to the abandoned server in its compound.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenSrcDesc_Market: Fixers who trust you sell fragments.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenSrcDesc_Hack: Sometimes behind Black ICE or a core command ICE.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHungerFine: Content: it works and waits for its next meal.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHungerStarving: Starving: it loses trust every day until fed.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAIHungerRun: Starving and distrustful: it is about to run away into the net.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAITraitsReveal: Every AI wakes with up to two traits; the first shows at trust {0}, the second at {1}.
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenWorkValue: about {0} hours of work at the server, faster with hacking speed
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenNoiseValue: at Heat 50 a {0} chance someone notices: +{1} Heat
LanguageData.NR_HelpAwakenTraitsValue: a random archetype; {0} wake with no trait, the rest with one or two
LanguageData.NR_HelpFixerTraitsReveal: A fixer's trait shows at reputation {0}, or when the fixer gives themselves away.
LanguageData.NR_DiveTrait: {0} has earned a lasting mark from the net: {1}.\n\n{2}
LanguageData.NR_PermitScrubDone: {0} has wiped the colony's trace from public logs: Heat -{1}.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsMinimapTip: A small map of the whole net in the corner; the frame shows the view, a click jumps there.
LanguageData.NR_SettingAutopause: Autopause on threats along a route
LanguageData.NR_SettingAutopauseTip: When a patrol or an intrusion appears on a runner's route in cyberspace, the game pauses once with a letter.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFirstHintsTip: A short tour the first time the terminal opens, and one card the first time ICE, Netsick, a fixer or an AI event appears.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsGlossaryTip: While you are new (the Newcomer preset, or the first 15 days of a game): when a tooltip of the mod mentions Heat, ICE, Netsick, cyberdata or trace, a short definition is added under it.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsWasd: Move the cyberspace map with W A S D
LanguageData.NR_SettingsWasdTip: Off by default: these keys may be bound to the game's camera.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsHubScaleWarn: More hubs make the map and the game heavier (lower TPS). Applies to maps created after the change.
